gbm_population_evidence.quote: Window-of-opportunity trial in participants with MTAP-deleted GBM (Intervention Cohort 7)

candidate_evidence.quote: It is thought to work by blocking the protein arginine N-methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Concentration of BAY 3713372 in enhancing and non-enhancing brain tumor tissue obtained at definitive surgery, with corresponding time-matched plasma concentrations and estimation of tumor-to-plasma exposure ratios

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change in symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) levels in brain tumor tissue collected at definitive surgery following neoadjuvant BAY 3713372 treatment, as a pharmacodynamic marker of PRMT5 inhibition

role_evidence.quote: A surgical window-of-opportunity trial of BAY 3713372 alone in participants with MTAP-deleted glioblastoma (GBM).

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PRMT5 inhibition, killing MTAP-deleted cancer cells while sparing normal cells
arms: Backfill cohorts in Intervention Cohort 1 (Dose Escalation)
Window-of-opportunity trial in participants with MTAP-deleted GBM (Intervention Cohort 7)

source_quote.quote: Homozygous MTAP-deletion identified through molecular testing from a locally certified laboratory.

coder_notes: Basket trial (NSCLC, PDAC, GBM cohorts); GBM named in the Cohort 7 arm label and keywords. Combination cohorts 3, 4 and 6 use unnamed 'other treatments', so no partners are listed; the GBM cohort 7 is monotherapy. Registered phase PHASE1/PHASE2. Treatment setting of the GBM window-of-opportunity cohort is not stated.
